text:
Hi everyone,

My wife's mother is planning to visit us for about 2.5–3 months around the end of October to help us out for a while. We're trying to understand if there's anything we need to do before she arrives.

I've seen a few posts saying that people can run into problems if they don't notify the Ministry of Interior in advance before a parent comes to visit. Is that actually required, or can she simply enter as a regular tourist?

For context, my wife is already an Israeli citizen and has an Israeli passport, but this will be her mother's first time visiting Israel.

Has anyone been in a similar situation? We'd really appreciate any advice or experience. Thanks!
